map.untranslated: SSP GOTOADDR KEP2 (25,3315-3316), the order KEP leaves in EDOP across RTB P66: it runs from the interpreter's DANZIG/OPJUMP when P66 returns, a point the transfer ABI does not key yet (interpretive routines are keyed by LOC at NEWOPS)
